needsNewNodes.name: Evaluating whole-number differences within 100
needsNewNodes.description: Evaluate a difference of two whole numbers within 100 when the result is nonnegative, including two-digit subtrahends and regrouping. Accept any valid elementary calculation route without requiring column subtraction.
needsNewNodes.reason: The catalog lacks a route-neutral node covering the displayed calculation 40 - 15 and its retained direct evaluation.

candidate.changeReason: 40 - 15 = 25 agrees with choice C. The brief calculation correctly and sufficiently answers the question.
